title: The isomorphism clause of the quasi-coherent Kunneth theorem
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X and Y schemes over k [def-pc-scheme], quasi-compact with affine diagonals, and F and G quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. For every n in N the direct sum over p+q=n of H^p(X,F) tensor_k H^q(Y,G) is k-linearly equivalent to H^n(X x_k Y, pr_1^*F tensor pr_2^*G), with pullback and tensor coefficients [def-pc-fibre-product], [def-pc-module-pullback]. The equivalence sends the pure tensor a tensor b in the (p,q) summand to the external cup product defined in [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. No functoriality assertion is made.

proof.text: For arbitrary scalar classes a and b, surjectivity of homologyπ (it is an epimorphism in ModuleCat) provides cycle representatives of alpha_p(a) and beta_q(b). The algebraic Kunneth generator formula provides the total tensor cycle z. Apply the geometric comparison formula to z. The inverse factor equivalences cancel alpha_p and beta_q, giving precisely the original externalCup formula with its degree cast. All of this transport is implemented in Lean.

lean.statement: theorem picard_kunneth_iso_exists (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [IsAffineHom (Limits.pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (Limits.pullback.diagonal g)] (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ e : (⨁ i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n}, scalarCohomology f F i.val.1 ⊗[k] scalarCohomology g G i.val.2) ≃ₗ[k] scalarCohomology (Limits.pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n, ∀ (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n}) (a : scalarCohomology f F i.val.1) (b : scalarCohomology g G i.val.2), e (DirectSum.lof k _ (fun j : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n} ↦ scalarCohomology f F j.val.1 ⊗[k] scalarCohomology g G j.val.2) i (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) = cast (congrArg (fun d ↦ ↥(scalarCohomology (Limits.pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) d)) i.property) (externalCup f g F G i.val.1 i.val.2 a b)
